name: Axis Robotics
description:
Axis Robotics (also known as Axis AI) is building a distributed scaling infrastructure and data engine for physical AI and robotics. The platform utilizes large-scale simulations where human contributors directly guide robots through tasks, transforming these interactions into meaningful training data for foundation models.

The project incentivizes data collection through a crypto-native reward system. By completing simulation tasks, such as object manipulation and pose control, users generate high-quality datasets. This crowdsourced approach allows for scalable robotic learning across different environments without the traditional bottlenecks of real-world experimentation.
